mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: 10 degrees now, broken clouds. Next 24 hours: high 17, low 9.

A pilot struggled to land at Madeira Airport in Portugal as Storm Charles brought strong winds and heavy rain, creating extremely difficult conditions.

US diplomatic teams will travel to Moscow on Tuesday to meet President Vladimir Putin, following two days of Abu Dhabi talks mediated by the United States aimed at advancing Ukraine negotiations.

Researchers at the University of Zurich have developed a new test that can detect the date-rape drug GHB up to three days after it has been consumed, potentially improving forensic investigations.

In Budva, Montenegro, gunmen opened fire at a restaurant near the main traffic lights, killing one person and wounding another.

German technology firm Singulus Technologies signed a €60 million contract with Elon Musk to supply solar cells for his upcoming line of smart watches.
